quest.title: Backup Plans
quest.description: Aino's working on a backup plan to save her friends...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hmm... Should I continue my research or not?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: To be precise, this is a testing platform for Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1, the latest stealth robot of Aino's design.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: She recently purchased an abandoned cleaning bot from the black market. After modifying it, she created the Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1 you see here today.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: This platform has simulated several hostile environments to test the robot's ability to maintain stealth under pressure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why's Aino making this stealth robot again?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: After the theft of Krum-Clank 70% Sweet, Aino made up her mind, and declared: "No matter how powerful the foe, we have to rescue our friends!"

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Then she quickly completed the draft of Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1 and started its development.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: According to her plan, once the development is complete, it should be able to infiltrate even the heavily guarded Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau with ease to rescue our friends.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: But Aino soon realized that perfecting the plan would take far too long — so she wanted to abandon the idea. As per her calculations, it would be much faster to just turn all of Nod-Krai upside down.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: I've made up my mind! Since we're taking things nice, chill, and easy, I'll just keep working on Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1! It'll definitely help us save our friends!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: In that case, could we ask you two to assist with the tests?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Based on past statistics, having data provided by other testers as reference will increase Aino's development speed by at least 30%.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Count Paimon in! This sounds like fun!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Then I thank you both on Aino's behalf. I will grant you access permissions to the platform — from now on, you can use it for any testing you need to conduct.
